newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian serial killer strikes again.
newsitem.headline: Russian serial killer strikes again.

text.p: Russian police in the Urals city of Perm are on the trail of a serial killer who has claimed his seventh victim in just a few months, Itar-Tass news agency said on Tuesday.
In the latest attack, the killer raped and stabbed a young woman in a lift, leaving her body on a landing. Tass did not say exactly when it took place.
Police earlier released a suspect after women who had survived an attack failed to identify him.
